description: Get titles TMDB considers similar to a given movie or TV show, based on shared genres and keywords — a blunter heuristic than get_movie_recommendations'/get_tv_recommendations' behavioral (co-viewing) data, so results are often thematically noisy (verified live: The Matrix's first page mixes Videodrome and Dune with The Man with the Golden Gun). Returned exactly as TMDB ranks them, 20 per page; the list runs into the whole catalog (total_results 20001 for The Matrix), so only the first page or two are worth reading. Try recommendations first for thematically closer picks; use this when you specifically want genre/keyword-adjacent titles. Get the id from search_movies/search_tv.

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination (TMDB returns up to 20 results per page, max 500).

name: get_similar

vote_average.description: TMDB's own 0-10 user score. A different audience and scale from the IMDb/RT/Metacritic scores get_movie/get_tv return as `ratings` — don't compare, average or substitute across the two.
